Rookgaard quest in the Premium area. Enter through the Premium troll cave, cross a bridge while {creature:Goblin|Goblins} pelt you with stones, go down into the goblin temple and climb up to the chest room. You receive 50 gp, 4 {item:Snowball|Snowballs}, 5 {item:Small Stone|Small Stones}, some {item:Sandals}, a {item:Pan} and a {item:Vial} of milk.
Optional: {item:Spear|Spears} or {item:Small Stone|Small Stones} to kill the trapped goblins
Cross the bridge quickly: the goblins throw stones at you.
The goblins also attack in melee, not only with stones.
With a {item:Shovel}, go to the troll cave in the Premium zone of **Rookgaard** and go down. Once down there, follow the map.
Entrance to the Premium troll cave
Path through the troll cave to the bridge
Keep heading **south**. Before the bridge you will meet {creature:Troll|Trolls} and {creature:Orc|Orcs}. Run across the bridge: the {creature:Goblin|Goblins} **will** throw stones at you.
On the bridge you are exposed to the goblins' stones: do not stop.
On the other side of the bridge there is a staircase going down. Down there are goblins (they attack in melee and throw stones): kill them or run, and follow the map again.
When you go down you meet 3 goblins. On the **north** side there are 3 more trapped goblins, which you can only kill with {item:Spear|Spears} or {item:Small Stone|Small Stones}.
Go up to the chest room

You will see a staircase going up. Up there are 3 {creature:Goblin|Goblins}, 1 {creature:Minotaur}, 1 {creature:Orc Spearman} and 1 {creature:Wasp}. Kill them all and open the chests to receive the reward.
50 gp, 4 Snowballs, 5 Small Stones, Sandals, Pan and a Vial of Milk

Go back the same way: go down from the chest room, return through the temple to the staircase and climb it, run across the bridge again (the goblins throw stones again) and head **north** through the troll cave to the hole you came in by. Climb up with the {item:Rope} to return to the surface of the Premium zone of Rookgaard.
Entrance/exit of the Premium troll cave
On the bridge you are exposed to the goblins' stones again: do not stop.
Before the Winter Update 2007, the {item:Pan} could be traded with {npc:Billy} for an antidote rune. Now he gives you a {item:Small Health Potion} in exchange.
